widgets_values: 参考图像最多只能接入9张图像，如果不接入就关掉下面的开关

如果只要单采那就不要开启二阶段采样，分辨率选择器里选择你要的分辨率大小，推荐0.9，直出720p视频。
如果要开二阶段采样，那一阶段的分辨率就要调小，推荐0.4，先用低分辨率快速跑完一采，然后再用较低的步数再二次采样，此时二次采样就可以将分辨率拉高，根据自己的配置和需求来调（太高了也会影响速度）

PS：本地跑的话，可以先不开二采，先用一采来快速抽卡，抽到满意的，把种子锁定然后开二采来强化。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, high-fashion editorial, a medium-wide shot frames a tall Asian female model with sleek long black hair, sculpted cheekbones, and flawless glossy makeup, wearing a crisp white high-end silk blouse with the top buttons loosely undone, a bright red mini skirt, sheer nude stockings, and white pointed high heels, her long bare legs emphasized by the thigh-length skirt. She stands against a seamless dark-grey studio backdrop with large softbox lighting from the front and a cool rim light tracing her silhouette, a faint haze drifting through the light beams. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as she slowly turns her body toward the lens, one hand sliding down to her hip, the silk blouse and skirt catching the light with each subtle movement. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of her torso, legs, and face as she tosses her hair back with one hand, tilting her head slightly and shifting her weight to one hip, the red mini skirt swaying and the white heels lifting her posture. The camera arcs around her with small amplitude at slow speed while she runs her fingertips along the collar of the blouse, her gaze following the camera with a confident, composed expression. [Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of her face and shoulders as she lifts her chin, fixes her eyes directly into the lens, and lets a subtle, knowing smile form at the corners of her lips. The camera pushes in slowly with very small amplitude, then holds a static shot as she brushes a strand of hair from her cheek and holds the final editorial pose until the end of the video.

overall_soundscape: Quiet studio ambience with a low ventilation hum underneath, soft fabric rustling gently as she moves, and a faint airy whoosh from the studio fan passing through the frame.

non_diegetic_music: A minimalist electronic fashion-runway track at a moderate tempo with a steady four-on-the-floor kick, deep pulsing bass, airy synth pads, and crisp hi-hat accents; the energy rises subtly in the middle and ends with a clean, confident stop as she holds the final pose.

Cinematic horror close-up, realistic 4K live-action. Image 1 is the character identity reference (exact face, brown hair in ponytail with braided top section, small stud earring, purple vest with orange trim over white collared shirt only; ignore background). 

A young East Asian woman matching the reference (brown hair pulled back into a ponytail with neat braids on top, fair skin, brown eyes, small diamond stud earring, wearing a purple vest with orange piping over a white collared shirt) is trapped against a dark grimy concrete corner in a tight claustrophobic space. She looks upward with wide tear-filled eyes, mouth already open in pure terror. Directly above her, a pale fleshy grotesque monster with sharp teeth hangs upside-down from the ceiling. The monster slowly lowers its head, opens its wide sharp-toothed mouth, and extends a long wet slime-covered tongue that steadily descends and inserts deep into the woman’s open mouth, pushing further into her throat.

As the thick tongue forces its way into her throat, the woman opens her mouth even wider in extreme panic, her eyes bulge wide open with more tears streaming down her cheeks, body tensing against the concrete wall. Thick strands of saliva and slime drip continuously from the tongue and her stretched lips.

The camera performs a slow continuous close-up push-in with small amplitude, tightening from medium close-up to extreme close-up on her face, the invading tongue, and her bulging eyes. Dim cinematic lighting with harsh side highlights and deep shadows, realistic wet textures on skin, tongue, and concrete.

Sound: low dripping water, wet slimy sliding and deep squelching as the tongue enters her throat, soft panicked breathing turning into muffled choked gasps and whimpers, faint concrete echo.
non_diegetic_music: N/A

Live-action cinematic sports footage, realistic outdoor pickleball court under a large white tensile canopy with blue “US NATIONAL PICKLEBALL CENTER” banners and bleachers full of spectators. Image 1 is the strict character identity reference for the Asian man (exact face, short hair, glasses, light blue t-shirt, grey shorts, white On Cloud shoes, black paddle with red accents). 

The man is in the foreground on the green and blue court, crouched in a low athletic ready stance, eyes locked on the incoming yellow pickleball. He steps forward with his left foot, rotates his hips and shoulders, and executes a powerful forehand drive, swinging the black paddle in a clean, sharp arc that makes solid contact with the ball. The ball compresses slightly against the paddle face then rockets forward with a visible yellow blur. Immediately after contact he follows through fully, weight transferring onto his front leg, paddle finishing high, face intense and focused.

A female opponent in a red shirt with “Sarah” printed on the back stands near the net in the mid-ground, paddle ready. The camera starts at a dynamic three-quarter tracking shot that follows the man’s body movement from behind and slightly to the side, then smoothly pushes in with medium speed into a tight heroic close-up of his face, upper body, and paddle at the exact moment of impact and follow-through, keeping him sharp and centered.

Bright natural daylight with soft canopy shadows, realistic court texture and spectator motion in the background. 
Sound: sharp “pop” of paddle striking the plastic ball, shoe squeaks on the court surface, light fabric rustle of his shirt, distant crowd murmur and occasional claps. 
non_diegetic_music: N/A
